name: pushman
description: Send intentional iPhone notifications and manage your Pushman sender with OAuth.

interface.shortDescription: Send requested notifications to your iPhone.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Pushman account with Google or Apple. Send notifications when requested, inspect receiving devices, history, monthly usage and delivery, rename or disconnect this sender, and obtain privacy-safe diagnostics. No CLI installation is needed for hosted OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Show my Pushman usage without sending a notification.
Check my eligible Pushman receiving devices.
Help me connect my Pushman account.
